rules.title: SF Rent Ordinance just cause eviction
rules.requirement: A landlord of a unit covered by the Rent Ordinance may evict only for one of 17 listed just causes, which must be the dominant motive. Expiration of a lease or a change in ownership is not just cause; removing housing services also needs just cause.
rules.quoted_span: In order to evict a tenant from a rental unit covered by the Rent Ordinance, a landlord must have a "just cause" reason that is the dominant motive for pursuing the eviction.

unverifiable_exemptions: some tenancies where the rent is regulated by another government agency

rules.coverage_conditions: Covers units under the Rent Ordinance, including those exempt from rent increase limits (post-1979 CO, Costa-Hawkins).
rules.penalty: Substantial civil and/or criminal liability for unlawful or attempted eviction.

rules.title: SF relocation payments for no-fault evictions (owner move-in, demolition, capital improvement, rehabilitation)
rules.requirement: Landlords evicting for owner/relative move-in, demolition or permanent removal, temporary capital improvements, or substantial rehabilitation must pay relocation. For notices served 3/1/2026–2/28/2027: $8,245 per tenant, max $24,733 per unit, plus $5,497 per elderly/disabled tenant or household with a minor child.
rules.quoted_span: Relocation Payments for Evictions based on Owner/Relative Move-in OR Demolition/Permanent Removal of Unit from Housing Use OR Temporary Capital Improvement Work* OR Substantial Rehabilitation
rules.effective_date_note: Start of current published rate period; original enactment date not stated.

unverifiable_exemptions: Rent Ordinance exemptions (e.g., owner type, subsidized housing)

rules.exemptions: Temporary capital improvement evictions under 20 days are governed by Cal. Civ. Code § 1947.9.

rules.title: SF relocation payments for Ellis Act evictions
rules.requirement: Tenants evicted under the Ellis Act are owed relocation payments. For notices served 3/1/2026–2/28/2027: $11,110.05 per tenant, max $33,330.13 per unit, plus $7,443.90 per elderly (62+) or disabled tenant.
citation_aliases: SF Rent Ordinance Ellis Act relocation
rules.quoted_span: Relocation payments for tenants evicted under the Ellis Act
rules.effective_date_note: Start of current published rate period; original enactment date not stated.
rules.review_note: Section 37.9A inferred from D083 multilingual link label 'Relocation Payments 37.9A'.

rules.title: SF Rent Ordinance annual allowable rent increase
rules.requirement: For rent-controlled units, the annual allowable increase is 1.6% of base rent for March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 (1.4% prior year). Units with a first CO after June 13, 1979 and Costa-Hawkins-eligible tenancies are exempt from the limits.
rules.quoted_span: For rent-controlled units, the annual allowable increase amount effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6%.
rules.effective_date_note: Start of current allowable-increase period; underlying ordinance predates it.

unverifiable_exemptions: tenancies regulated by another government agency

rules.title: SF security deposit interest rate
rules.requirement: Landlords must pay interest on tenant security deposits at the Rent Board rate: 4.2% for March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 (5.0% prior year).
citation_aliases: SF Rent Board security deposit interest rate
rules.quoted_span:
Security Deposit Interest:
4.2% for March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027
rules.effective_date_note: Start of current published rate period.
rules.review_note: Ordinance section not stated in the documents; cited by chapter.

rules.title: SF ban on algorithmic rent-setting devices
rules.requirement: Landlords may not sell or use algorithmic devices that analyze nonpublic competitor rental data to set rents or manage occupancy. Tenants or the City Attorney can sue; damages, injunctive relief and civil penalties up to $1,000 per violation, each unit-month possibly separate.
rules.key_value: ban on algorithmic devices using nonpublic competitor data; up to $1,000 per violation
rules.quoted_span: The law prohibits the sale or use of such algorithmic devices and allows a tenant or the City Attorney to bring a civil action if they believe an entity is in violation of the law.
rules.effective_date_note: Official Rent Board page states it went into effect October 14, 2024.
rules.penalty: Civil penalties up to $1,000 per violation

rules.title: San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance (affordable housing)
rules.requirement: In San Francisco affordable housing decisions, residents and applicants with an arrest or conviction history are protected under the Fair Chance Ordinance. The page gives no further detail.
rules.key_value: protection for arrest/conviction history in affordable housing decisions
rules.quoted_span: San Francisco's Fair Chance Ordinance protects residents with arrest or conviction history in affordable housing decisions

requires_unknown_facts: unit is in an affordable housing project
